about.title: About me
paragraphs: I'm a Full-Stack developer passionate about building software that solves real problems. Over the past few years I've built Java and Spring Boot microservices for the banking sector, developed web applications with Python and Angular, and specialized in AI agents and process automation.
I'm proactive and hard-working: I like to anticipate what a project needs and see every task through to the end. I'm curious by nature, which drives me to explore new technologies and keep learning.
